text: …　はしを　わたるのが　こわくて　ずっと　ここに　かくれてたんだ

structure.jp: …　はしを　わたるのが　こわくて
ずっと　ここに　かくれてたんだ
structure.en: I've been hiding here the whole time

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like '-ing' in English. はしを　わたるの = 'crossing the bridge'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The くて ending joins this part to the next one, and here it gives the reason for what follows. こわくて = 'it was scary, so'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ and shows the speaker is explaining himself. かくれてた is short for かくれていた. かくれてたんだ = 'you see, I was hiding'.
